Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

tidytracks (development version)

New features

  • New interface to the package ctmm, to fit continuous-time movement models to tibbles of tracks (see the new article “Movement models with ctmm”). This includes the new functions: mt_as_telemetry(), ctmm_tt_fit(), ctmm_tt_summary(), hr_tt_akde(), and hr_tt_akde_pop()
  • hr_tt_ud_sum() now works with tables of UDs without a bandwidth column h.
  • hr_tt_locoh(), a fast implementation to estimate home ranges with local convex hulls (LoCoH).
  • hr_tt_kde() gains a method argument. Its new default, "binned", bins the locations onto the grid and then smooths them with the kernel, which is much faster for many locations (see the article “Benchmarking home ranges against amt and adehabitatHR”).
  • New track_tot_distance() to compute the total distance travelled along each track, with a units argument to choose the output units.

Minor improvements

  • Speed improvements (same results) for hr_tt_mcp(), hr_tt_kde() and hr_tt_ud_iso().

Documentation

  • New article, “Benchmarking home ranges against amt and adehabitatHR”, which compares the time taken by the MCP, KDE and LoCoH estimators of tidytracks, amt and adehabitatHR on tracks simulated with amt, and checks that they give the same home ranges.

tidytracks 0.2.1

Bug fixes

  • hr_tt_kde(h = "h_ref_indiv") no longer assigns the bandwidths to the wrong groups when the tracks are not stored in the order of the groups.
  • tt_split_trips() no longer uses the centre of another track, or mislabels events, when the events are not in the same track order as the metadata, are interleaved, or are not ordered by time.
  • event_flag_mcconnell() and tt_clean_mcconnell() no longer run forever when a track contains a duplicated record or an event without a location.
  • tt_read_data() reads dates with 2-digit years correctly (e.g. 15/01/24 was read as 24 January of year 15), and joins metadata with numeric track ids.
  • hr_tt_ud_overlap(method = "udoi") computes the UDOI of Fieberg & Kochanny (2005), as adehabitatHR does; the previous values depended on the resolution of the grid.
  • hr_tt_ud_overlap() gives an error, instead of an overlap of 0, when the isopleth used with cond_level (or for the UDOI) contains no cells of the grid, i.e. when a single cell holds more than that proportion of a UD.
  • hr_tt_ud_iso() keeps holes in isopleths instead of filling them in.
  • hr_tt_kde() and hr_tt_mcp() give an informative error for a grouping with groups without events (e.g. from grouping by a factor with unused levels with .drop = FALSE), showing how to remove them; hr_tt_kde() failed with “subscript out of bounds”, and hr_tt_mcp() ignored them.
  • hr_tt_kde() returns isopleths (when levels is set) of class hr_tt_poly_tbl, as hr_tt_ud_iso() does.
  • track_duration() and track_summary_health() return the tracks in the order of the metadata.
  • Functions work with geometry columns that are not called geometry.
  • tt_split_trips(), hr_tt_kde() and hr_tt_mcp() handle events without a location, and hr_tt_kde() and hr_tt_mcp() handle groups with few locations.
  • tt_regular_time() places interpolated points of projected tracks correctly, keeps the type of track ids and non-syntactic column names, and gives non-numeric columns the value of the observation at the last time.
  • tt_write_data() writes times in UTC, with fractional seconds, so that they are not shifted when read back with tt_read_data().
  • event_distance(), event_speed() and event_flag_mcconnell() give an informative error for objects without a CRS.

tidytracks 0.2.0

  • Rename functions to hr_tt_ prefix to avoid name clashes with other packages. (NOTE the old names are still available for backwards compatibility, but will be deprecated in future releases.)
  • Allow group specific grids for hr_tt_kde()
  • Add earth mover distance to hr_tt_ud_overlap()
  • Ensure that all track_* functions return values in the same order as in the metadata.

tidytracks 0.1.0

  • Optimisation for hr_tt_ functions and UD raster storage in tibbles to improve speed of hr_tt_ud_overlap()
  • Minor bug fixes and documentation updates.
  • Implement hr_tt_ud_sum() to sum multiple UDs.

tidytracks 0.0.1

  • Initial public release.
